mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a short-term risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% in a 3-month window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market, which, when combined with slowing consumer demand (CPIAUCSL), signals a broader economic slowdown that depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST decline simultaneously and CPIAUCSL is below 3.0% annualized, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO < 100.0), a decline in industrial production signals reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annualized compresses real interest rates and increases inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth rate falls below 50,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals weakening labor market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth falls below 50,000 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, which, when combined with slowing GDP growth (GDPC1), signals an economic downturn that depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST decline simultaneously and GDPC1 growth is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing expansion regimes (INDPRO > 102.0), a rise in industrial production signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 102.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
